title: [Main]-Export Electronic Payments: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No.
summary: Fixed a bug where exporting electronic payments could incorrectly clear one vendor's Document No. field if another vendor in the batch had a missing email address.
key_points: One vendor's missing email no longer corrupts another vendor's payment data
Electronic payments export now properly validates vendor email independently
Bug affected bulk vendor remittance reporting functionality
Test coverage added for the edge case scenario
quote: Export Electronic Payments: one vendor's missing email can clear another vendor's Document No.
